title: Teletalk Bangladesh Ltd - Bondhu Shondhan
text:
Bondhu Shondhan
Bondhu Shondhan
is a subscription based SMS Chat service which offers you unlimited browsing of other users profile, exchange messages with other users of the service, create chat-rooms, Communication is anonymous so don’t worry about intrusive calls or bothersome messages from other chat users in the future.
How to use Bondhu Shondhan
Dial *16480# to register in the system. Then follow these steps:
Choose your gender, once you select you will be registered
After registration, you will enter the main service menu
Enter the chat
Relogging
Sign out
Language
Info
Enter the chat
After selecting 1 (Enter the chat), you will receive a list of subscribers, who are ready for chatting.
For Example:
You - F22. Choose the partner:
M22
M32
M21
M22
More
After choosing the partner, you will receive USSD-answer and SMS from *16480# number with the following information.
You can start chatting with M32. Send SMS to 16480 and your partner will see your message!” From here every message you send to 16480 will be forwarder to your chat partner.
Leave the chat
In order to leave the chat you have to dial *16480#
The following information will be displayed in the response menu:
You are in the chat with M32. 1. Leave the chat”
choose 1 to leave the chat.
Deactivate the service
To deactivate the service you have to dial *16480# and select 3 (Sheba Bebosta) Deactivation), then press 2 (subscription bondho korun)
